summary: How a transition speeds up and slows down along the way.
details: ease (the default) starts quickly and settles gently. ease-out starts fast and slows down, which suits things appearing or responding to the user; ease-in starts slow, which suits things leaving. cubic-bezier() and steps() give full control.

values.note: Constant speed: good for spinners, mechanical for most else.
Overshoots a little, then settles: a gentle bounce.
Jumps in four steps, no in-between.
